measurement_policy.cpu_policy: first CPU in current process Cpus_allowed_list; same CPU for every measured run
measurement_policy.network_policy: disabled for all runtime measurement and diagnostic containers
measurement_policy.startup_boundary: fresh child JVM ProcessBuilder.start() through child exit, from a driver already running inside the container; Docker container creation/start is excluded
measurement_policy.warmup_boundary: same compiled Protos CallTarget, fresh module activation per equivalent iteration; bootstrap/source read/parse/lower are outside each timed interval
measurement_policy.steady_boundary: same JVM and CallTarget after the retained warmup curve; fresh module activation is constructed before each timed guest call
measurement_policy.diagnostic_boundary: separate non-timing run with TraceCompilation enabled; diagnostic data is never used as timing samples
measurement_policy.aggregation: median primary; MAD, min, max, p95 secondary; raw samples retained
